bachelor:software-systems-and-technologi.overview: Software Systems and Technologies (BSc Hons) at VUM is a Cardiff Met dual-award programme combining software engineering fundamentals with industry-aligned internships and practical projects.

bachelor:software-systems-and-technologi.duration: Full-time (3 years typical; 3 / 3.5 / 4 year options with APL)
highlights: Modular ECTS structure with downloadable curriculum
admissionNotes: English language requirements and APL pathways apply

master:master-of-business-administration.overview: The MBA at VUM is an international, Cardiff Met–validated programme focused on management, strategic leadership and applied business practice.
master:master-of-business-administration.keyFocus: Strategic management, finance, marketing and leadership
highlights: Dual award MBA with Cardiff Met
Dissertation (15 ECTS) and core modules totalling ~90 ECTS
Mobile student networks and international mobility opportunities
admissionNotes: Requires a relevant bachelor degree or equivalent professional experience
Check Cardiff Met admission alignment for postgraduate entry requirements
